intro.data: A real inverse works both ways. Start from the packed blob, Decode it, then re-Encode — you should get the very same blob back. One encoder restores it; the other makes a different blob. Pick the true one.
intro.alchemy: A real inverse works both ways. Start from the dust, Recast, then re-Grind — you should get the same dust. One restores it, the other differs. Pick the true one.
intro.spellcraft: A real inverse works both ways. Start from the glyph, Read, then re-Etch — you should get the same glyph. One restores it, the other differs. Pick the true one.
intro.abstract: Start from B, apply g then f, and return to the same B value. Pick the true encoder.

goal.data: Decode then re-Encode back to the very same packed blob.
goal.alchemy: Recast then re-Grind back to the same dust.
goal.spellcraft: Read then re-Etch back to the same glyph.
goal.abstract: Round-trip back to the original B value.

description.data: unpacks the blob back into data
description.alchemy: recasts the powder back into ore
description.spellcraft: reads the glyph back into a spark

afterSuccess.data: Decoding then encoding restored the original blob exactly: f ∘ g = id_B. With g ∘ f = id_A from before, Encode and Decode are inverses — an isomorphism, A ≅ B.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Recasting then grinding restored the dust: f ∘ g = id_B. With the other round trip, Grind and Recast are inverses — A ≅ B.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Reading then etching restored the glyph: f ∘ g = id_B. With the other round trip, Etch and Read are inverses — A ≅ B.
afterSuccess.abstract: The other round trip also returned home: f ∘ g = id_B. With both, f and g are inverses — A ≅ B.

reveal.summary: An isomorphism is a morphism with a two-sided inverse: g ∘ f = id_A and f ∘ g = id_B. The two objects are then interchangeable, written A ≅ B.
reveal.moreFormal: If both round trips are identities, f is an isomorphism and its inverse is unique.
